Public procurement

DGDP enlisted.

Vision Trade International is a DGDP Enlisted Supplier & Contractor and participates in DGDP tender processes.

VTI supports relevant tender and project work through manufacturer communication, technical documentation coordination, compliant supply planning and local service capability.

Different settings, one standard

Systems selected for the institution behind them.

Competition venues, training facilities and public institutions have different operational demands. VTI coordinates the solution around the setting, users and lifecycle responsibilities.
